findings.text: Global proportion state offers initialization that starts period at zero and prepares event counting and sequencing, teardown that releases event counting, and period advance that sums events then under interrupt masking and sequence protection applies decay and subtracts aged events while bumping period.

Local proportion state offers initialization that zeroes event counting and period and prepares locking, teardown that releases event counting, event addition that first brings local period current then updates local and global counts, fraction query with sequence retry and clamping, and capped addition that may reduce or skip the increment to respect a maximum share.

Local period synchronization first returns quickly when already current, otherwise takes interrupt saving lock and rechecks for concurrent progress, then either decays stored value by shifting when the lag fits within word width with exact summation fallback for small values, or resets to zero when lag is huge, finally publishing the global period.

Global period advance serializes with interrupt masking plus sequence write bracketing, local period synchronization serializes with interrupt saving raw spin locking around the recheck and counter adjustment, and fraction query uses sequence read retry around reflection and positive reads.

Fraction query enforces denominator positive and fraction not above unity despite counting error by promoting denominator to numerator when denominator is not larger and forcing denominator to one when both values are zero.

Period advance takes no action when total events are at most one, and applies shift based decay only when the requested period count is below a fixed bound while still accounting the full delta in the global period.

Per CPU counting offers global set that clears every per CPU shard and installs a central total, and batched addition that accumulates in the local shard until magnitude reaches a threshold at which point local and new amounts are folded into the central total.

Counter set holds interrupt saving raw spin protection while clearing shards and storing the central total, and both batched addition variants hold similar protection only on the flush path with one using compare exchange retry locally and the other using interrupt masking with direct local update.

Firmware helper defines a family discriminator with common plus HMAT plus PRMT plus CEDT plus CDAT values and an entry wrapper pairing a header union pointer with that discriminator to select the matching view for later type length and size queries.

Firmware helpers offer entry type extraction with constant zero for PRMT, entry length extraction with endian conversion for CDAT, header size lookup per family, table identity classification from four byte signatures, overall length with CDAT conversion, handler dispatch preferring plain then argument forms, array walk with identifier matching and counting, and CDAT wrapper building a single filter request.

Array parsing clamps table length to an optional maximum, starts after a fixed header size, loops only while a full header fits before table end, calls handlers only for identifier matches within an optional entry cap while counting per filter and total matches, advances by per entry length, and warns when matches exceed the cap.

Parsing reports invalid argument when a handler fails, when an entry length is zero to avoid nontermination, when the CDAT wrapper sees a null header, and when handler dispatch finds no handler at all.

Generic pool keeps a list of chunks each with virtual span and physical base and owner and available count and allocation bitmap, while the pool itself keeps minimum allocation order and chunk list and lock and default placement strategy with opaque data and optional name.

Bitmap helpers offer single word set that fails if any target bit is already set and single word clear that fails unless every target bit is already set, plus range set and clear that iterate word by word using first and last word masks and return the unprocessed remainder on contention.

Pool lifecycle offers creation with minimum order and node affinity defaulting to first fit with null data and name, chunk addition that derives bit count from size shift and links with full availability, destruction that unlinks and frees chunks and name and pool, and device managed lookup by name where null matches only unnamed pools.

Pool use offers virtual to physical translation by containing chunk scan, algorithmic allocation with optional owner output, DMA allocation with aligned and zeroing variants delegating through algorithm forms, release with optional owner output, per chunk iteration, full containment test, and summed available and total size queries plus strategy replacement defaulting empty strategy to first fit.

Placement strategies offer plain first fit, alignment aware first fit deriving mask and offset from requested alignment and pool order and start address, fixed offset placement succeeding only at the requested offset, order aligned first fit using rounded power of two size, and best fit scanning for the smallest enclosing free run with early exit on exact size.

Chunk insertion uses spin protection while translation allocation release iteration containment and size queries traverse under read side RCU, bitmap updates use lock free compare exchange with retry, and allocation rolls back partial sets before retrying placement within the same chunk.

Allocation and release round byte size up to pool order granularity, skip chunks with insufficient availability, adjust availability by the rounded size, and allocation of zero bytes returns zero address without touching any chunk.

Destruction requires no allocation bits remain set, release requires the range lie inside a single chunk with all bits previously set and faults when no chunk contains the address, allocation forbids nonmaskable interrupt context on some builds and requires rollback completeness, and fixed placement warns on misaligned offset.
Batched proportion threshold equals eight times one plus binary logarithm of possible CPU count.

Pool allocation and release with DMA aligned and zeroing forms serve as external entry points for carving and returning subranges from pooled chunks with address translation and optional owner reporting.
Firmware array walk and CDAT wrapper serve as external entry points for scanning variable length subtable sequences and dispatching matched entries to caller handlers with counting.

Algorithmic allocation scans chunks in order, skips those with insufficient availability, asks the strategy for a candidate start, attempts lockless set, on contention clears partial progress and retries the same chunk, and on success publishes the derived address while charging availability and reporting owner.
